scope: Bounded late-time background-only comparison; no spectra, cosmological sampling, changes to existing targets, or claim of exact historical reproduction.

cases.declared_three_species: Literal physical interpretation of header: omnuh2=.00083, three degenerate massive species with total degeneracy3.0, plus .046 massless effective species. Set these fields explicitly and verify the complete CAMB state. This is not certified to have run in the historical chain.
cases.modern_one_species: mnu=.06eV, num_massive_neutrinos=1, nnu=3.044, CAMB standard_neutrino_neff=3.044; retain the same total Omega_m by setting CDM after the actual neutrino density is known.
cases.contemporary_interface_candidate: Pre-chain public CSL maps omnuh2 to mnu=93.14*omnuh2, ignores legacy massless_nu, and does not read massive_nu. Evaluate a declared contemporary CAMB1.3.5-default interpretation: one massive species, nnu=standard_neutrino_neff=3.046, with CDM from the original .00083 density. Record any resulting actual Omega_m drift; this is a candidate mapping, not historical replay.

numerics: 27 get_background(no_thermo=True) evaluations, plus one ordinary thermal-background and one AccuracyBoost2 comparison for each central case:33 background calls maximum. Compare central native D_A to independent adaptive integrals of CAMB H(z). Matter+Lambda reference uses96-node Gauss-Legendre integration. Spectral entry points are forbidden.
uncertainty_diagnostic: Fit a quadratic to nine delta-loglike values in fixed coordinates x=(Omega_m-.33245)/.03, y=(H0-73.55)/1.5. Use its gradient/Hessian with the already qualified matter+Lambda posterior covariance to report a LOCAL curvature-based mean/width perturbation. Preserve fit residual and SPD failure; this is not a recomputed posterior or global coverage bound. A relative H0-width perturbation >=1% is a follow-up flag, not a scientific acceptance gate.
